subject: Character roles
scope_and_rationale: One character definition per playable role with a domain ID (HF-05 line 18). It references its four slot trees (F-03) and its start-available weapon and mobility actions and world-one main skill and ultimate (F-02) by ID and expected family. Candidate pilots N-007 to N-011 are instances of this type, not an admitted roster (BIBLE line 273).

subject: Attacks
scope_and_rationale: One attack definition per committed player, device, companion or enemy action: preview shape, committed geometry, targets, telegraph and recovery, resolved once and shared by damage and presentation (BIBLE line 493). Enemy (SC-04), device and companion (SC-06) definitions reference attacks by ID; a scene may not override them (TADR-003 line 27).

subject: Upgrades
scope_and_rationale: One slot-tree definition per character slot with the fixed 15-node, 14-edge, eight-endpoint shape validated at admission (TADR-003 line 31; HF-05 line 50). Nodes and edges are embedded records inside the tree definition, addressed as tree ID plus node key; endpoints are the referents of recipes (F-08). Node effects, costs and milestone allocation remain open (BIBLE line 538).

subject: Encounters
scope_and_rationale: Encounter, wave, boss and objective definitions with domain IDs, referencing enemy archetypes (SC-04) and their attacks (F-02). Exact counts and timing belong to the tested encounter (BIBLE line 521); the definition carries the authored arrangement, not tuning evidence.

subject: Generation policies
scope_and_rationale: Region, level-module, route, exit and generation-constraint definitions that bound seeded assembly (BIBLE line 580) and destination eligibility (line 169). Resolved offers, routes and seeds are RunState (HF-03a line 45), never definition fields. World count, repeat policy and starting world are open product parameters recorded as symbolic constraints.

subject: Devices
scope_and_rationale: Device definitions with identity, deployed-action references (F-02) and compatibility declarations. Capacity, lifetime, recall, resource and cross-level persistence are typed symbolic fields whose values Q-P15 supplies; the schema requires their presence, not a value (BIBLE line 568). Cross-level persistence is HF-06b's save column, not this treatment.

subject: Companion parts
scope_and_rationale: Companion chassis, component and command-capability definitions assembled into the one main companion (BIBLE line 570). The assembly itself is RunState companion assembly (HF-03a line 45). Under every Q-P15 answer at least the chassis is an authored definition, so the family stays schema even if interchangeable components collapse to one.

subject: Recipes
scope_and_rationale: Fixed-secret recipe definitions: an eligible combination of endpoint references (F-03) producing one fixed effect identifier (BIBLE line 562; HF-05 line 58). Eligibility, bonuses, tradeoffs and disclosure are the Q-P14 content; the schema holds under every answer because they are validated references and reviewed behavior identifiers (TADR-003 line 23), not values chosen here.

subject: Reading the catalogue
scope_and_rationale: Editorial guidance for the area catalogue. Its run-shape facts (four worlds, one world boss each, two random eligible destination offers) are validation constraints on F-05 definitions and on TH-11's lifecycle contract, not an authored definition. SC-05 confirms that no region is admitted as a launch roster by this row.

subject: Yard Commons
scope_and_rationale: Candidate region instance of the SC-05 region definition (F-05): landscape family, terrain vocabulary, encounter and reward themes as references to SC-04 enemies, SC-03 items and SC-07 cues. This row fixes the type, not the admission of this candidate; no starting-world assignment (BIBLE line 181).

subject: Spillway Works
scope_and_rationale: Candidate region instance (F-05). Water-current handling and traversal variables are open and stay symbolic (BIBLE line 207). Reward vocabulary references SC-03 items; encounter themes reference SC-04.

subject: The Iron Orchard
scope_and_rationale: Candidate region instance (F-05). Snipcart, Spreadleg and the Pruner arm are prototype mechanisms cited as SC-04 references; the Grand Pruner boss and generated orchard levels remain proposals (BIBLE line 225). The browser orchard is not this definition's evidence.

subject: Foundry Crown
scope_and_rationale: Candidate region instance (F-05). The older mass-gated rail proposal is unadopted (BIBLE line 243), so no weight threshold or steering field belongs in the type. Reward vocabulary references SC-03.

subject: Pale Basin
scope_and_rationale: Candidate region instance (F-05) with no finale assignment (BIBLE line 251). Sliding, traction and weather mechanics are unchosen (line 261) and are not fields.

subject: 4.1 Sable, fox from the Switchback Enclaves
scope_and_rationale: Candidate pilot instance of the character definition (F-01): civilization reference, kit slot references (F-02 weapon, main skill, mobility and ultimate) and four slot trees (F-03). A/B/C construction sheets are SC-07 visual references; arc and barks are SC-08 dialogue. Not a selected roster (BIBLE line 273).

subject: 4.2 Kest, bird from the Highdraft Roosts
scope_and_rationale: Candidate pilot instance (F-01) with the same reference shape as N-007. Shallow hover only, not unrestricted flight (BIBLE line 317); rotor clearance and camera occlusion need later motion studies and are not fields.

subject: 4.3 Tarn, tiger from the Redjaw Workshops
scope_and_rationale: Candidate pilot instance (F-01) with the same reference shape as N-007. Planted limbs are temporary actions of F-02 definitions, never a separate walking body (BIBLE line 338).

subject: 4.4 Fuse, squirrel itinerant apprentice
scope_and_rationale: Candidate pilot instance (F-01). Miscasts are SC-02 chaos-outcome references through TH-13; element pool, failure rate and self-damage are open (BIBLE line 359) under Q-P13, which this card does not register, so those fields stay symbolic. The lightning prototype is reference material, not evidence for this kit.

subject: 4.5 Rivet, mole machinist
scope_and_rationale: Candidate pilot instance (F-01). Beam thickness, reflection eligibility and movement during sustained fire remain future rules (BIBLE line 380) carried by the referenced F-02 attack definitions.

subject: 4.6 Supporting cast and relationships
scope_and_rationale: Non-playable narrative identities (Moss, Admiral Brindle, the Furnace Fleet) as SC-08 narrative and dialogue definitions with domain IDs so optional exchanges and aftermaths reference them. A boss role for Brindle would be an SC-04 encounter referencing this identity; that role is unchosen (BIBLE line 386).

subject: 5.1 Shared baseline and class roles
scope_and_rationale: The class kit (start-available weapon and special mobility, world-one unlocks for main skill and ultimate) is a record embedded in each character definition (F-01), validated by the start-access and world-one rules at admission (HF-05 line 54). The E01 weapon and device silhouettes are SC-07 visual references on the F-02 and F-06 definitions they depict.

subject: 5.2 The mech builds its advances
scope_and_rationale: Each upgrade node and endpoint in a slot tree (F-03) embeds a visible-construction change reference resolved through SC-07 visual references, so an upgrade is never a cosmetic attachment alone (BIBLE line 681). The binary tree shape is settled on F-03; costs, supply and milestone allocation remain open (line 432). Growth mechanics are TH-05.

subject: 5.3 Finds that belong to their area
scope_and_rationale: Item definitions with material provenance and a region-theme reference (F-05) so themed drops belong to their area (BIBLE line 436). Drop tables, final effects and required counters are not prescribed; compatibility is a Q-P14 field validated by reference, so the type holds under every answer.

subject: 5.4 Attunement and transformative combinations
scope_and_rationale: Attunement is a compatibility declaration embedded in an item definition, naming eligible character, item, device and companion IDs by expected family (HF-05 lines 22 and 56). Transformative replacement of movement or attacks is an effect reference to F-02. Companion assembly through loot references F-07; chassis and component slots stay symbolic under Q-P15. Prototype Ground Loop, Echo, Shear and Brace behaviors are not admitted rules (BIBLE line 452).

subject: 5.5 What a discovery changes
scope_and_rationale: Permanent unlock and discovery definitions carry domain IDs so profile knowledge references them by ID (HF-05 line 58). Acquired item, selected endpoint and active fixed-secret bonus are RunState and EffectiveBuild records (HF-03a line 45), not definitions. Which recipe knowledge exists is Q-P14; when a discovery becomes durable is Q-E09 Persistence timing and does not change the definition.

subject: The complete loop
scope_and_rationale: Run loop states (encounter, intermission, world transition, terminal) are Session lifecycle contract (TH-01; HF-03a line 45), not authored catalogue content. World and level definitions already have rows under F-05.

subject: Movement, camera and active aim
scope_and_rationale: Movement, camera and aim behavior is Encounter and CollisionQueries runtime contract (TH-02; HF-03a lines 46 and 47). Per-character mobility actions are F-02 definitions; camera settings are N-029. Prototype tuning is not a universal specification (BIBLE line 485).

subject: A committed attack means what it shows
scope_and_rationale: The committed attack definition (F-02): preparation, committed danger shape, height, weapon-origin obstruction and recovery, resolved once and shared by collision, preview, effects and damage (BIBLE line 493; TADR-003 line 27). Chaos miscast outcomes are SC-02 chaos-outcome definitions through TH-13; warning timing and disclosure remain design work (line 497).

subject: Abilities, ultimates and combat rhythm
scope_and_rationale: Ability and ultimate definitions with availability, cooldown, charge-source and effect references (TH-04). Exact triggers, duration and tuning stay symbolic (BIBLE line 503). Prototype lightning charge mechanics are not the definition.

subject: Electromagnetic collection, recycling and growth
scope_and_rationale: Collection, recycling and growth are encounter runtime behavior and presentation feedback (TH-05; cues under N-051), with no Bible-named authored definition type. Costs and supply remain open (BIBLE line 513). If TH-05 defines a recoverable-material definition, this row is re-verified.

subject: Encounters, waves and enemies
scope_and_rationale: Enemy archetype, wave, miniboss and boss definitions (F-04) referencing attacks (F-02) and regions (F-05). Snipcart, Spreadleg and the Pruner arm are prototype examples, not an admitted roster (BIBLE line 521).

subject: Four slots and milestone progression
scope_and_rationale: Slot-tree definitions (F-03): four per character, 15 nodes, 14 edges, eight endpoints, one selected connected lineage per slot with no crosspathing (BIBLE line 529; HF-05 lines 50 and 54). Milestone allocation, node effects, costs and respec scope are open (lines 538 and 542); a respec opportunity is an SC-05 event definition (TH-07).

subject: Inventory, equipment and transformations
scope_and_rationale: Equipment, shared-modifier and transformation definitions declaring effects and compatibility (HF-05 line 56). Inventory and equipped selections are RunState and EffectiveBuild is rebuilt from selections (HF-03a line 45). Inventory capacity and slot limits are not established (BIBLE line 550); compatibility content is Q-P14 and is carried as references.

subject: Themed loot, attunement and fixed secrets
scope_and_rationale: Fixed-secret recipe definitions (F-08): eligible endpoint combination to one fixed effect (BIBLE line 562). Discovery knowledge is ProfileState referencing the recipe ID; when it commits is Q-E09 and belongs to HF-06b and HF-07b. Disclosure and eligibility are Q-P14 content, carried as references and identifiers.

subject: Devices and one main companion
scope_and_rationale: Device (F-06) and companion-part (F-07) definitions with autonomous action references (F-02) and compatibility. Capacity, lifetime, recall, resource and persistence rules are symbolic fields under Q-P15 (BIBLE line 568); prototype conductor limits are not values. A companion rescue does not grant a standard revival (line 572).

subject: Runs, regions, exits and saves
scope_and_rationale: World (run-region) and exit definitions (F-05) with destination-eligibility constraints for the two random offers (BIBLE line 580). Resolved offers, checkpoints, revival and terminal facts are RunState and DurableAggregate (HF-03a lines 45 and 49; HF-07a). Revival placement is Q-P16; durable timing of discoveries surviving defeat is Q-E09 and does not alter this definition.

subject: HUD, dashboard and settings
scope_and_rationale: Interface settings definitions (sensitivity, sound, UI scale and impact shake ranges and defaults) and dashboard-state presentation references (BIBLE line 602). Live HUD snapshots are Presentation records (TH-12) and stored preferences are PreferencesRecord (HF-07a). Controller mappings need hardware evidence.

subject: Architecture and implementation handoff
scope_and_rationale: Governance prose assigning definitions, encounter simulation, run state, permanent progression and rendering. HF-03a owns the module allocation; TH-20 reconciles every authored row to its admitted SC definition. Browser proof paths are not production content.

subject: AD-01. Visual identity
scope_and_rationale: Frozen art-direction rule. It constrains SC-07 visual references and TH-19 asset review; it is not an authored definition.

subject: AD-02. Palette
scope_and_rationale: Named palette swatch definitions (name, hex, primary use) as SC-07 visual references shared by materials and UI. The eight swatches are the proposed revision for this gate (BIBLE line 624), so this row fixes the type, not the admitted values.

subject: AD-03. Lighting
scope_and_rationale: Lighting guidance. Regional lighting conditions are SC-07 visual references on region definitions, not a definition type of their own.

subject: AD-04. Render style and materials
scope_and_rationale: Material and render-style rule for asset authoring and TH-19 review; no definition.

subject: AD-05. Steam-cyberpunk technology and recycling
scope_and_rationale: Technology aesthetic rule. The collect, process and construct sequence is presentation feedback (N-046 and N-051) and assigns no cost or schedule (BIBLE line 651).

subject: AD-06. Southwest landscapes
scope_and_rationale: Landscape-family guidance consumed as a symbolic landscape-family reference on region definitions (F-05); it selects no region list or route order.

subject: AD-07. Civilizations and class expression
scope_and_rationale: Civilization guidance consumed as a symbolic culture reference on character definitions (F-01) and the glossary cultures (N-056); candidate directions, not roster assignments.

subject: AD-08. Composition, scale and interface
scope_and_rationale: Camera composition, scale-reference and HUD framing rules for rendering integration (TH-16) and interface presentation; no definition.

subject: AD-09. Mood words
scope_and_rationale: Mood vocabulary for tone review. It names no object, cue or rule that could become a definition; SC-07 consumes it as guidance only.

subject: AD-10. Reference descriptors
scope_and_rationale: External influences never become content (BIBLE line 673; TADR-003 line 35). SC-07 and SC-08 confirm that no reference is authored as an inhabitant of the world.

subject: AD-11. Never
scope_and_rationale: Prohibitions applied at asset and concept review; TH-19's admission checks consume them as review criteria.

subject: Applying the approved direction
scope_and_rationale: Introduction to the teaching scenes; proposals only, no definition.

subject: Materials should explain the work
scope_and_rationale: Material-pass guidance for artists; consumed by SC-07 visual references and TH-19 asset review.

subject: Light belongs to a place
scope_and_rationale: Regional lighting and vegetation guidance. Region definitions carry presentation references from SC-05 to SC-07; no separate type.

subject: A silhouette has a job
scope_and_rationale: Class-sheet silhouette guidance; consumed by SC-07 visual references on F-01 characters.

subject: Make fabrication visible
scope_and_rationale: Guidance for collection and upgrade illustration; realized through the visible-construction references of N-014 and the cues of N-051, not a definition.

subject: Preserve the decision inside the spectacle
scope_and_rationale: Combat readability rule for effects and rendering (TH-16). The illustrated footprint verifies no hitbox (BIBLE line 735).

subject: Sheets that another artist can use
scope_and_rationale: Concept-sheet production and labeling practice. Sheets are source assets with provenance under TH-19, not definitions.

subject: The machine should sound made by someone
scope_and_rationale: Audio direction statement and production-scope note. Browser WebAudio proofs are a starting vocabulary, not admitted cues (BIBLE line 747).

subject: Music direction
scope_and_rationale: Music arrangement definitions: shared material, intensity layers, phrase-boundary transitions and per-region character referencing F-05 regions (BIBLE line 759). The regional table selects no route.

subject: Sound palette and audible information
scope_and_rationale: Audio cue definitions keyed to committed results and UI requests (TH-17): attraction, fabrication, movement, class identity, telegraphs, UI, revival and discovery. Cues are consumed from committed results and never decide outcomes (HF-03a line 51).

subject: Movement, impacts and combat rhythm
scope_and_rationale: Per-action feedback binding (cue, camera response, recovery tail) embedded in the presentation definition of an action, referencing F-02 attacks and SC-07 cues. It is a proposed timing grammar that claims no implemented camera behavior (BIBLE line 784).

subject: Spectacle that leaves room to play
scope_and_rationale: Mix priority and voice-cap policy for audio integration (TH-17), plus the separate music, effects, camera-motion and dynamic-range controls under N-029; no definition.

subject: Audio and motion concept sheet
scope_and_rationale: Concept image F01 with provenance; a labeled proposal, not engineering proof or a definition.

subject: Illustrated identity key
scope_and_rationale: Concept image G01; it assigns no home regions or route order and selects no chassis.

subject: Game, people, cultures and places
scope_and_rationale: Glossary entry definitions (canonical name, status, definition) for pilots, cultures, regions, organizations and characters, each referencing the F-01, F-05 or narrative definition it names so the glossary is not a second truth (TADR-003 line 35).

subject: Named mechanisms and equipment
scope_and_rationale: Glossary entry definitions for named mechanisms, items, companion and enemies. Entries marked prototype refer to browser proofs and are references, not admitted SC-03, SC-04 or SC-06 content (TADR-003 line 35).

subject: External references and technical names
scope_and_rationale: References are influences or production terms, never inhabitants of the fictional world (BIBLE line 811); no definition may be authored from them.

subject: Common system terms
scope_and_rationale: Shared vocabulary whose meanings are fixed by the system rows (attunement N-016, endpoint F-03, fixed secret bonus F-08, respec N-024, standard revival and world N-028). Re-authoring them would create a second editable truth (TADR-003 line 35).
